chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Abū Ayyūb al-Khazzāz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: “The absent man and the absent woman are not subject to stoning, unless the man is with the woman and the woman is with the man.”

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man, mentioned in relation to being with the woman
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman, mentioned in relation to being with the man
key_terms.الْمُغِيبَةُ: the absent woman, meaning a wife apart from her husband
key_terms.الْمُغِيبُ: the absent man, meaning a husband not present with his wife
key_terms.رَجْمٌ: stoning as a prescribed legal punishment in this context

ai.seo_question: When does rajm apply according to the hadith of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام about the absent man and woman?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the application of rajm in a case involving spouses being apart. It indicates that stoning does not apply to the absent husband and absent wife except where the man is with the woman and the woman is with the man.
